payload.text: The wire→types AtmConvention mapping is a total 1:1 lift of the two ATM conventions: `From<WireAtmConvention> for AtmConvention` matches AtmForward→AtmForward and DeltaNeutralStraddle→DeltaNeutralStraddle explicitly, no wildcard. DeltaNeutralStraddle is the dominant interbank ATM (its strike is the premium-adjusted-aware F·e^{±½σ²T}, docs/CONVENTIONS.md), distinct from AtmForward (K=F). This seam carries that selection from the wire onto `celnet_types::AtmConvention` with no possibility of silent enum drift. Pure: a match returning the mapped enum, mutating nothing.
